data.name: Biswajit
data.long_meaning: Biswajit is a Sanskrit name derived from the words 'Biswa' meaning 'all' and 'Jit' meaning 'conquered'. This name signifies the one who conquers or rules over all aspects of creation. In Hindu mythology, Biswajit is an epithet of Lord Vishnu, the preserver of the universe.
